screened_linear_ridge.selection: largest absolute training covariance with centered target

screened_pair_ridge.selection: largest absolute training covariance between centered target and standardized off-diagonal feature product

validation.preprocessing: StandardScaler and feature or pair selection fitted independently inside every training fold
validation.evaluation: frozen 4096-row held-out cohort from the source diagnostic

gates.decision: reference_adequate only if every required candidate/head cell passes at both dimensions and both sample sizes
